craftos-mcp test file.description: A *.test.lua file for craftos-mcp's ccunit harness: run the program for a while, then check its monitor
body: -- Runs ${1:program}.lua and checks its monitor. craftos-mcp test (or the Testing view) runs this file in a fresh
-- computer, in ${TM_FILENAME_BASE/\.test$//}.world.json when there is one next to it (its "monitors" attach).
-- the program draws into a window over the monitor, so the test can read the text back
if kind == "monitor" then return screen end
for y = 1, height do lines[y] = screen.getLine(y) end
-- the program runs until it ends or ${2:2} seconds pass
parallel.waitForAny(function() shell.run("${1:program}.lua") end, function() sleep(${2:2}) end)

ccunit.eq.description: Fail unless the two values are equal (tables compare deeply)

ccunit.truthy.description: Fail unless the value is truthy; the message is shown when it fails

ccunit.raises.description: Fail unless the function errors with a message matching the Lua pattern
